chunks: Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
about the khaluq of the Kaʿbah and the khaluq of the grave being present on the garment of ihram.
So he said: “There is no harm in them; both are pure.”

key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave, whose khaluq is also mentioned in the question
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaʿbah, whose khaluq is being asked about
key_terms.ثَوْبِ الْإِحْرَامِ: the garment worn in the state of ihram
key_terms.خَلُوقِ: a perfumed substance or fragrance mixture referred to in the ruling
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection in legal terms

ai.seo_question: Is the khaluq of the Kaʿbah or the grave allowed on the garment of ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning substances such as khaluq associated with the Kaʿbah and the grave when found on the ihram garment. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that there is no problem with them and affirms their purity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2612 - Hammad ibn Uthman asked Abu Abdullah (as)
about the khaluq of the Ka'bah and the khaluq of the grave that might be present on the Ihram garment.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in them; both are pure."
